mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ar.total_amount - ar.received_amount - ar.bad_debt_amount), 0) FROM fin_ar_order ar WHERE ar.customer_id = #{customerId} AND ar.status = 'OPEN' AND ar.del_flag = '0'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.order_amount), 0) FROM mk_order o WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.order_status IN ('2', '3') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mk_invoice i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.del_flag = '0' )
